metadata.summary: UK Biobank is a prospective, population-based cohort of ~500,000 participants aged 40–69 recruited across the United Kingdom, with deep longitudinal phenotyping: genetic, lifestyle, electronic health records, imaging, and biosamples. Roughly 100,000 participants have multimodal MRI (brain, heart, abdomen) plus further imaging.
metadata.purpose: Supports myriad epidemiological and ML studies

ethics.license: application-based access (academic free tier / industry fee)
ethics.privacy_measures: De-identification; strict data access controls; secure research environment (RE)
ethics.legal_compliance: Complies with UK Data Protection Act 2018 and GDPR

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.
pending_verification: geography.countries is heuristically inferred from limitation text; requires manual verification
The following LLM fields were auto-dropped for violating schema constraints and reverted to baseline; pending manual review: medical_fields[list-items]

bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: UK-only; underrepresentation of younger adults, ethnic minorities, and socioeconomically disadvantaged groups
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: Limited coverage of non-White ethnic groups; regional variation in recruitment density across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Imaging data available for only ~20% of cohort; EHR linkage incomplete for some participants

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Real-time clinical decision support; direct patient-facing deployment without validation

data_origin.selection_rationale: Prospective, population-based cohort recruitment across the UK
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Participants aged 40–69 recruited from general population across UK; imaging sub-study (~100,000) is a subset

population.target_population: Adults aged 40–69 in the United Kingdom
population.missing_groups: Underrepresentation of younger adults (<40), children, and certain ethnic minority groups relative to UK population; healthy-volunteer bias

annotation.annotation_method: Phenotype curation from EHR, imaging reports, and manual review; genomic variant calling pipelines
